sections.heading: Donald Trump — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Donald Trump was born on 14 June 1946 in Jamaica Hospital Medical Center, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Donald John Trump at birth and is publicly known as Donald Trump.
Public records name his father, Fred Trump and his mother, Mary Anne MacLeod Trump. He is a sibling of Maryanne Trump Barry, Robert Trump, Fred Trump Jr. and Elizabeth Trump Grau.
He received his education at Fordham University, The Wharton School, The Kew-Forest School and New York Military Academy.
He is recorded as speaking English and American English.

sections.heading: Donald Trump — Career and Professional Work
paras: Donald Trump works primarily as a business magnate, investor, politician, game show host, real estate entrepreneur and television producer, with The Trump Organization listed among his employers.
Among the credits most often linked to Donald are Trump: The Art of the Deal, Crippled America and The Apprentice.
He has held the following offices: President of the United States (2025–present). He is affiliated with Republican Party.

He has taken part in 2018 North Korea–United States Singapore Summit, Trump–Ukraine scandal, 2016 United States presidential election, 2020 United States presidential election and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018.
